lines.text: The root is Vac! Vacation, vacuum.
Did you know? Vac is Latin for empty.
Vacation: a time of empty days.
Quick quiz! Which means an empty space?
Vacuum! It means an empty space.

words.ex: She requested two weeks of vacation in August.
The cleaners vacuum the carpets in every office each night.
